name: Gates of Olympus Xmas 1000

features.name: Pay-anywhere tumble
features.description: Eight or more matching symbols anywhere on the 6x5 grid pay, and winning symbols are replaced by new ones.

features.name: Multipliers up to 1,000x
features.description: Multiplier orbs can land on any spin; their values are combined and applied to the spin's total win.

features.name: Free spins with running multiplier
features.description: Four or more scatters award 15 free spins; every multiplier adds to a total that boosts later wins, and three scatters retrigger five more spins.

review:
The festive Gates of Olympus 1000 – snow-dusted crowns and gems, same engine underneath. Eight or more matching symbols anywhere pay and tumble away.

Zeus drops orbs from 2x up to 1,000x, added together at the end of a spin. Four scatters start 15 free spins with a running multiplier total, which is how 15,000x becomes possible – though most bonuses end far below that. A high-variance seasonal reskin. 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
